destination.title: Bounces, singularities and dimensional selection
destination.question: Can higher-dimensional or brane dynamics change cosmological singularities, produce bounces or select the number and size of large dimensions?
destination.summary: Keep induced bounces, collision cosmologies, brane-population selection and singularity dynamics distinct.

conventions: An induced-metric bounce is not automatically a bounce of every effective metric
includes: Generic singularity billiards as an alternate comparison topic
excludes: Equivalence of early brane-gas selection and late filling-fraction selection

sources.title: Time dependent string compactification: towards bouncing cosmology

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactification with constant lower-dimensional Newton constant permit external NEC violation and a nonsingular bounce while respecting the higher-dimensional condition motivated by worldsheet symmetry?

sources.title: Brane gases in the early universe

evidence.text: Does including fundamental branes beyond strings preserve the proposed avoidance of the initial cosmological singularity and selection of at most three large spatial dimensions? Can the resulting brane relic problem be resolved dynamically?

sources.title: The Ekpyrotic universe: Colliding branes and the origin of the hot big bang

evidence.text: Can a slowly moving bulk brane colliding with the visible boundary produce a hot universe, address horizon, flatness and monopole problems, and generate nearly scale-invariant density perturbations without inflation?

sources.title: Cosmological space-times from negative tension brane backgrounds

evidence.text: Can hyperbolic and planar Einstein–dilaton–Maxwell backgrounds be interpreted as fields of negative-tension branes, and support bouncing cosmological regions with physically meaningful horizons, charges and thermodynamics?

sources.title: Cosmological billiards

evidence.text: How does generic inhomogeneous Einstein–dilaton–p-form evolution near a spacelike singularity reduce to a hyperbolic billiard, and when does that billiard admit a Kac–Moody interpretation?

sources.title: Relaxing to three dimensions

evidence.text: Can cosmological dilution and annihilation of a higher-dimensional brane population select structures supporting three apparent spatial dimensions, through a dynamical 'relaxation principle' based on their late-time filling fraction?

sources.title: Can string theory avoid cosmological singularities?

evidence.text: Under what matter and dilaton conditions can a spatially flat, homogeneous, isotropic four-dimensional universe avoid cosmological curvature singularities, and could strong-coupling solitonic branes provide those conditions?

sources.title: Time dependent string compactification: towards bouncing cosmology

evidence.text: Decompose higher-dimensional Ricci components into external curvature and internal-metric/warp derivatives, then impose either pointwise or integrated Einstein-frame constraints. Appendix A supplies an algebraic non-negativity argument for tr[(h⁻¹∇̄_l h)²] without assuming diagonal h.

sources.title: Brane gases in the early universe

evidence.text: Insert gas energies and pressures into homogeneous dilaton-gravity equations; use classical world-volume intersection counting for annihilation and a two-dimensional phase portrait in l=λ̇ and f=ϕ̇ to investigate loitering.

sources.title: The Ekpyrotic universe: Colliding branes and the origin of the hot big bang

evidence.text: Expand the bulk-brane action to quadratic order in position fluctuations, solve the approximate mode equation using Bessel functions with a short-wavelength Minkowski vacuum, and convert brane ripples into radiation density fluctuations through collision time delays and Olson variables.

sources.title: Cosmological space-times from negative tension brane backgrounds

evidence.text: Analytic continuation of Schwarzschild provides a simple vacuum example; Kruskal-type coordinates construct its maximal extension. Conformal-time foliations expose bounce and radial-kink behavior.

sources.title: Cosmological billiards

evidence.text: Hamiltonian analysis uses the ultralocal Iwasawa decomposition g=Nᵀdiag(e^(−2βᵃ))N, with N upper triangular and unit diagonal, extended canonically to momenta. The β-space metric is Σ(dβᵃ)²−(Σdβᵃ)²+dφ².

sources.title: Relaxing to three dimensions

evidence.text: Higher-dimensional FRW evolution is combined with energy conservation and an averaged equation of state. A randomly oriented, noninteracting gas of d-branes has w=-d/n and density ρ_d∼a^(d-n). The authors compare dilution rates to test candidate dominant components.

sources.title: Branes on charged dilatonic backgrounds: Selftuning, Lorentz violations and cosmology

evidence.text: Can charged dilatonic bulk backgrounds support brane cosmologies and flat self-tuning branes while avoiding naked singularities or exotic matter, and what gravitational Lorentz violations follow from their asymmetric warping?

sources.title: Generalization of instanton-induced inflation and dynamical compactification

evidence.text: Can internal Yang–Mills instantons drive external expansion and dynamical compactification when the internal Einstein geometry and FLRW spatial curvature are generalized, and which geometries permit homogeneous cosmology or bouncing solutions?

sources.title: Bouncing brane cosmologies from warped string compactifications

evidence.text: Can a D3-brane moving through a smooth warped string compactification experience a controlled, spatially flat bouncing cosmology with four-dimensional gravity, and how would a brane observer describe it using a four-dimensional action?

sources.title: Mirage cosmology

evidence.text: Can a universe brane moving through higher-dimensional bulk fields acquire an induced cosmology that resembles expansion driven by brane matter? How do world-volume energy and apparent initial singularities enter this description?

sources.title: Constant curvature 3-branes in 5-D f(R) bulk

evidence.text: Can quadratic higher-curvature gravity in a warped five-dimensional bulk support curved branes and generate a radion potential with both metastable and stable minima? The paper also asks whether this setting permits bouncing cosmology and satisfies its stated swampland restriction.

sources.title: Expanding Universe and Dynamical Compactification Using Yang-Mills Instantons

evidence.text: Can Yang–Mills instantons in four extra dimensions drive accelerated expansion of four-dimensional spacetime together with contraction of the internal space, without introducing an independent inflaton and an ad hoc inflation potential?

sources.title: Regular Black Hole Interior Spacetime Supported by Three-Form Field

evidence.text: Can the fixed-sphere, expanding-dS2 behavior motivate higher-dimensional compactification or an effective reduction of spacetime dimensions at high curvature? Could a related mechanism illuminate de Sitter cosmology despite negative matter potentials?

sources.title: Four-Dimensional Null Energy Condition as a Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a hierarchy of quantum corrections in an M-theory completion constrain the effective stress tensor of external four-dimensional cosmology, even when the higher-dimensional sources violate energy conditions?

sources.title: Allowable complex scalars from Kaluza-Klein compactifications and metric rescalings

evidence.text: Can lower-dimensional matter fields be complex while retaining the convergence property imposed on their higher-dimensional geometric origin?

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Which fluxes and quantum corrections can support an assumed type IIB de Sitter metric, and can those ingredients remain time independent?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can evolving internal geometry and fluxes support IIB four-dimensional de Sitter isometries with constant Newton's constant? The paper studies this through an M-theory uplift and quantum-correction hierarchies.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can evolving internal shape and fluxes restore quantum control while keeping the effective gravitational coefficient constant? The paper compares constant-volume and varying-volume branches with a fixed type IIB coupling.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactification geometry, fluxes and quantum corrections support four-dimensional de Sitter isometries with constant Newton coupling and a controlled effective field theory, despite obstructions found for time-independent internal configurations?

sources.title: How a four-dimensional de Sitter solution remains outside the swampland

evidence.text: Can internal time dependence and quantum corrections support four-dimensional type-IIB de Sitter solutions with an effective field theory, and why does the corresponding time-independent ansatz fail?

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in the String Landscape: La Petite Version

evidence.text: Can a type IIB compactification with an external de Sitter metric retain an effective description when its internal warp factors and fluxes evolve, while the axion, type IIB dilaton and four-dimensional Newton constant remain fixed?

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Specify the kinetic metric, compute the directional derivative, apply the dual-norm inequality, and divide by the displacement norm. This transfers a premise rather than generating a universal positive constant.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Project each sector of the target-minus-soliton metric onto solitonic modes and use those coefficients in a coherent-state exponential. Background fluxes must be supplied simultaneously; they are not automatically generated by the metric state.

sources.title: How a four-dimensional de Sitter solution remains outside the swampland

evidence.text: Count curvature, flux and derivative operators by their g_s and M_p scalings. Quantum stress-tensor scalings differ from potential scalings by constant shifts; external g_s-neutral equations select θ_k = 8/3.

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in the String Landscape: La Petite Version

evidence.text: Move to a dual description with an action, organize correction operators by field and derivative content, and compare their scaling with the field equations. Here this operation is applied to an M-theory uplift of type IIB de Sitter compactifications.

sources.title: Four-Dimensional Null Energy Condition as a Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Compute component scalings, add contraction and derivative contributions, then group operators by coupling and Planck order. The paper applies this imported bookkeeping to detect time-neutral families that would undermine a Wilsonian truncation.

sources.title: Allowable complex scalars from Kaluza-Klein compactifications and metric rescalings

evidence.text: Pull the parent metric's phase restriction through an explicit reduction map, keeping induced scalar phases and external metric phases together.

sources.title: Ghost-Free Stable Minkowski Vacua in Lovelock Compactifications on Irreducible Symmetric Spaces

evidence.text: Can higher-dimensional Lovelock gravity compactified on a compact irreducible symmetric space produce a locally ghost-free four-dimensional Minkowski vacuum, and can its radius modulus be isolated from competing negative-energy configurations?

sources.title: A Study of accelerating cosmologies from superstring / M theories

evidence.text: Can parameters in time-dependent vacuum, SM2-brane, and SD2-brane compactifications substantially enlarge transient accelerated expansion? Which internal curvatures permit it, and when is the ten-dimensional description trustworthy?

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Parametrically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Can the weak-coupling or large-volume runaway of a Calabi–Yau compactification provide slowly evolving dark energy? The paper tests the scalar-potential gradient in the combined dilaton and Kähler sector, rather than searching for a positive stationary vacuum.

sources.title: Hyperbolic compactification of M-theory and de Sitter quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can negatively curved M-theory compactifications support controlled four-dimensional accelerated expansion through curvature, Casimir energy and flux, while stabilizing internal metric and form-field deformations?

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Numerically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Can string compactifications realize dynamical dark energy where finite-order calculations remain reliable? The paper studies finite, large dilaton and volume rather than an uncontrolled order-one bulk or a strict asymptotic boundary.

sources.title: Constant curvature 3-branes in 5-D f(R) bulk

evidence.text: Can quadratic higher-curvature gravity in a warped five-dimensional bulk support curved branes and generate a radion potential with both metastable and stable minima? The paper also asks whether this setting permits bouncing cosmology and satisfies its stated swampland restriction.

sources.title: Asymptotic accelerated expansion in string theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can fixed-flux scalar runaways at infinite moduli-space distance support accelerated expansion while remaining within an asymptotic effective description?

sources.title: Braneworld effective field theories — holography, consistency and conformal effects

evidence.text: Can exactly localized braneworld matter arise continuously from five-dimensional fields, meaning convergence of their quantum effective actions and correlators? What consistency issues and observable effects distinguish the two descriptions?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can time-dependent warped compactifications satisfy quantum-corrected Einstein equations while preserving the type IIB de Sitter metric and a useful expansion hierarchy?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can a warped string compactification support positive four-dimensional curvature with controlled quantum corrections? The paper asks whether external deformations suffice or whether internal geometry and fluxes must also evolve.

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: How far can duality twists extend across string theories, fiber geometries, and twisted sectors while retaining controlled low-energy physics?

sources.title: Flat equivariant gerbes: holonomies and dualities

evidence.text: How do globally nontrivial flat Wilson-line and B-field-gerbe holonomies change string spectra and moduli, and generate dualities between compact flat manifolds and singular orbifold compactifications?

sources.title: String dualities and wedge singularities

evidence.text: Can a tentative worldsheet description of type IIA strings on S¹∨S¹, supplemented by strong-coupling physics, reproduce a weakly coupled type 0A frame, including its tachyon and doubled RR charges?

sources.title: Strong - weak coupling duality in four-dimensional string theory

evidence.text: What protected quantities support conjectural strong–weak SL(2,Z) duality of toroidally compactified heterotic strings, and which monopole and dyon states would an exact symmetry require?

sources.title: String theory dynamics in various dimensions

evidence.text: What controls string theories at strong coupling in dimensions d≥4, and can higher-dimensional dynamics explain four-dimensional S-duality?

sources.title: Heterotic and Type I string dynamics from eleven dimensions

evidence.text: Can an eleven-dimensional orbifold description determine the strong-coupling behavior of the ten-dimensional E₈ × E₈ heterotic string and give a geometric explanation of the conjectured SO(32) heterotic–Type I duality?

sources.title: Toroidal orientifolds in IIA with general NS-NS fluxes

evidence.text: Transport reference R-R polyforms, differentiate, and match operator coefficients. Restrict outputs to one lower/base index per flux; unrestricted generalized fluxes and R flux are not supplied.

sources.title: Flat equivariant gerbes: holonomies and dualities

evidence.text: Equivariant line bundles and gerbes are described through Čech data, connection-preserving lifts, bundle isomorphisms and group-cohomology constraints. Quantization and associativity determine which flat vertical gerbes exist.

sources.title: String dualities and wedge singularities

evidence.text: Worldsheet CFT junctions in the RNS framework; one-loop integration of massive superfields using heat-kernel/Seeley–deWitt expansions and partial resummation to extract kinetic corrections and induced dilaton gradients.

sources.title: Strong - weak coupling duality in four-dimensional string theory

evidence.text: Tests use instanton periodicity, Dirac–Schwinger–Zwanziger–Witten quantization, protected BPS mass formulas, mass derivatives for scalar Yukawa couplings, oscillator counting and triangle inequalities for decay thresholds.

sources.title: String theory dynamics in various dimensions

evidence.text: Uses dimensional reduction, Weyl rescaling, form-field dualization and T-duality to compare dilaton powers, compactification radii and charged-particle masses across descriptions.

sources.title: Heterotic and Type I string dynamics from eleven dimensions

evidence.text: Quantize topologically stable BPS wrapped membranes and apply double dimensional reduction. Match membrane-boundary gravitational anomalies to heterotic world-sheet anomalies using SO(8) triality and the bundle decomposition TM = N ⊕ TΣ.

sources.title: Five-branes and M-theory on an orbifold

evidence.text: Can M-theory on T^5/Z2 describe a strong-coupling limit of Type IIB on K3, while accounting locally for gravitational anomalies and the apparent mismatch between 32 fixed points and 16 missing tensor multiplets?

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Does a state-dependent instability persist in controlled time-dependent string backgrounds, and can dualities relate its loop and nonperturbative descriptions?

sources.title: Dynamical Cobordisms in General Relativity and String Theory

evidence.text: Can uniform, nonaccelerating expansion support controlled spatial interpolations between different effective string theories and compactifications, including changes in worldsheet orientability, while maintaining causal contact?

sources.title: Double Field Theory on Group Manifolds

evidence.text: Can closed string field theory around WZW group-manifold backgrounds yield a generalized DFT, clarify which constraints ensure gauge closure, and provide candidate string uplifts of non-geometric configurations?

sources.title: The Nonperturbative SO(32) heterotic string

evidence.text: Can the proposed nonperturbative IIB quotient construct the SO(32) heterotic string, explain its gauge sector through NS 9-branes, and describe what happens to world-sheet charges at finite coupling?

sources.title: Low energy models of string theory

evidence.text: Which compactification geometries and fluxes produce plausible four-dimensional string effective theories, and how do swampland constraints and nonrelativistic strings extend this discussion?

sources.title: T-duality for non-critical heterotic strings

evidence.text: Determine the global deformation spaces and T-duality groups of full-rank non-critical heterotic strings on a circle, and interpret their symmetry enhancements and dimension-changing tachyon condensation in terms of heterotic branes.

sources.title: M-theory on $S^1\vee S^1$ as Type 0A

evidence.text: Can an exotic M-theory compactification geometrize weakly coupled Type 0A, explain its tachyon condensation, and illuminate Type 0B strong-coupling dualities and stationary backgrounds?

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: Are the nearly tensionless strings in four-dimensional Type IIA two-form weak-coupling limits dual to weakly coupled strings? Mirror symmetry motivates an analogy with Type IIB, but the source leaves the identification unresolved.

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: Can an odd three-cycle degeneration lift to a coassociative T4 and generate a weakly coupled type II string in a TCS compactification?

sources.title: U duality of Born-Infeld on the noncommutative two torus

evidence.text: Can Born–Infeld theory on a noncommutative two-torus describe compactified D-brane dynamics with T-duality acting on fluctuations as well as global charges, and how can its extra parameter θ be related to the string B-field modulus?

sources.title: T-duality across non-extremal horizons

evidence.text: What happens when T-duality follows a Killing vector that changes from timelike to spacelike across a non-extremal horizon, and how can string embeddings interpret the resulting singularities?

sources.title: The power of M theory

evidence.text: What relations among higher p-branes and their tensions follow by identifying M theory on R9×T2 with Type IIB on R9×S1, and M theory on R10×S1 with Type IIA in ten dimensions?

sources.title: A Matrix Theory Construction of the IIA/IIB Wall

evidence.text: Can matrix string theory provide a non-perturbative lightlike interface between ten-dimensional IIA and IIB string theories, and determine what happens to strings, parity-odd states, and D0-branes crossing it?

sources.title: An SL(2,Z) multiplet of type IIB superstrings

evidence.text: Can charged string solutions of ten-dimensional type IIB supergravity furnish an SL(2,Z) multiplet, and does their circle-compactified spectrum identify IIB duality with the modular group of an eleven-dimensional compactification torus?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Can wrapped heterotic five-brane strings admit a weakly coupled geometric worldsheet description after uplift to the Hořava–Witten frame?

sources.title: Non-geometric backgrounds in string theory

evidence.text: How are non-geometric string configurations constructed and described through T-duality, torus fibrations, generalised and doubled geometry, and what effects do their fluxes have on compactification and closed-string algebraic structures?

sources.title: Evidence for F theory

evidence.text: Can compact Type IIB D-manifolds be constructed using seven-branes associated with different (p,q) strings, and does geometrizing the IIB SL(2,Z) coupling supply evidence for a twelve-dimensional F-theory?

sources.title: U-duality in quantum M2-branes and gauged supergravities

evidence.text: Can quantum M2-branes with flux and SL(2,Z) monodromy supply a microscopic interpretation of nine-dimensional type IIB triplet gaugings, their restricted mass parameters, and their U-duality groups?

sources.title: Unwinding strings and t duality of Kaluza-Klein and h monopoles

evidence.text: How can a string lose winding around a Kaluza–Klein monopole while conserving H-electric charge, what is the T-dual momentum-transfer process, and what do these processes imply for the full string description of the monopole backgrounds?

sources.title: D = 6, N=1 string vacua and duality

evidence.text: How do anomaly cancellation, compactification geometry, T-duality and conjectured strong/weak dualities organize six-dimensional N=1 string vacua and their nonperturbative transitions? The lectures also examine the resulting four-dimensional N=2 theories.

sources.title: D-brane primer

evidence.text: How do worldsheet string theory and T-duality lead to dynamical D-branes, their worldvolume gauge theories, R–R charges, and applications to string duality and spacetime geometry? These are preparatory lecture notes, rather than a paper organized around a new research result.

sources.title: The Manifestly Sl(2,Z) covariant superstring

evidence.text: Can the bosonic action describing the SL(2,Z) orbit of (p,q) strings be extended to a manifestly covariant type IIB superstring action with local κ-symmetry in supergravity backgrounds?

sources.title: Timelike T duality, de Sitter space, large N gauge theories and topological field theory

evidence.text: What are the timelike T-duals of Type II string theories, and can their E-branes and supersymmetric de Sitter backgrounds motivate large-N Euclidean gauge/string dualities and topological twists?
